verdict.stance: Neutral / ADNOC-OMV Polyolefins Champion Scaling GMTN Takeout (A-/A/Baa1)
verdict.summary: Formed in 2026 by combining ADNOC/OMV's Borouge, Borealis, and $13.4bn Nova Chemicals, Borouge Group International generated $2.7bn 9M26 Adj EBITDA (26% margin) and $1.2bn FCF. Fitch assigned a final A- Stable rating (S&P prelim A / Moody's Baa1) in Nov-26 for its GMTN programme to refinance the $9.4bn Nova acquisition bridge, though YE26 proforma leverage (~3.9x) requires disciplined equity/FCF deleveraging.

positives: Industry-leading 26% Adjusted EBITDA margin ($2.7bn in 9M26) and $1.2bn FCF backed by low-cost Abu Dhabi/North American ethane feedstock.
Strong strategic parentage from ADNOC (AA) and OMV, earning Fitch A- Stable / S&P A / Moody's Baa1.
Global scale across Middle East, Europe (Borealis), and North America (Nova Chemicals).
negatives: Heavy ~$9.4bn acquisition bridge facility (maturing up to Mar-28) drives ~$16bn-$18.5bn initial debt and ~3.9x YE26E leverage.
Execution risk on planned equity capital raise and benchmark GMTN bond supply overhang.
Global petrochemical overcapacity and European Borealis margin cyclicality.

background.ownership_governance: Co-owned by ADNOC and OMV AG, headquartered in Austria/UAE (ADX-listed platform).
